title: PERMIAN BASIN ROYALTY TRUST ANNOUNCES RESULTS OF SPECIAL MEETING CALLED BY SOFTVEST

body_markdown:
DALLAS


, Nov. 23, 2026


/PRNewswire/ -- Argent Trust Company, as trustee ("Trustee") of the Permian Basin Royalty Trust (NYSE:PBT ) ("Permian" or the "Trust"), today announced that at the special meeting of the holders of units of beneficial interest of the Trust (the "Units" and such holders, the "Unitholders") held on November 23, 2026, called at the request of SoftVest, L.P. ("SoftVest") and certain other Unitholders holding in excess of 15% of the Units, Unitholders voted to approve an amendment to the Trust's indenture to effect the transactions contemplated by the Combination Agreement, dated as of July 28, 2026 (the "Combination Agreement"), by and among PBT Land and Minerals, Inc. ("New PBT"), PBT Sub, Inc., PBT Land and Mineral OpCo, LLC, Blackbeard Holdings, LLC ("Blackbeard"), Blackbeard Security Holdings, LLC ("Blackbeard Security") and Greybeard Energy, LLC ("Greybeard" and, together with Blackbeard and Blackbeard Security, the "Blackbeard Parties"). Pursuant to the Combination Agreement, certain assets of the Trust will be combined with certain oil and natural gas mineral interests and land operations owned by the Blackbeard Parties to create New PBT, a new publicly traded corporation. Unitholders also voted to approve and adopt the New PBT omnibus incentive plan.


The amendment to the Trust's indenture approved by the Unitholders contemplates, among other things, the termination and liquidation of the Trust. The Trustee anticipates that the effective date of the termination and liquidation of the Trust will be December 1, 2026 (assuming both of the closings contemplated by the Combination Agreement have occurred as of such date). As a result of the termination and liquidation of the Trust, each Unitholder is expected to receive one share of Class A common stock of New PBT for each Unit owned by such Unitholder as of the termination date.
